messagingReplyUntil.description: Epoch seconds until which a reply still reaches the person. On Messenger and Instagram this is Meta's 7 day HUMAN_AGENT deadline, restarted by each inbound message; classound applies the tag itself, so this is the one deadline a client has to show. 0 means the deadline is not known, which is what the inbound event carries when the session row was gone before it could be read back; it does not mean the window has closed, so a client reads the window as closed on `messagingReplyUntil > 0 && now > messagingReplyUntil` and shows nothing at 0. Absent on a channel with no reply window.
